entities.name: Evangelical Church of the Augsburg Confession in Slovakia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Evangelical Church of the Augsburg Confession in Slovakia is the only Lutheran church in Slovakia. The Church is a member of the Ecumenical Council of Churches in Slovakia, and the Lutheran World Federation.
